title: Exact Persisted Inventory Evidence Resolution
selectedSlice: exact production-batch and physical-movement persisted read APIs
purpose: Expose narrow exact persisted reads required to resolve FOOD-006C evidence-manifest identities before any recorded-balance composition.
rules: Caller exact identities are validated before database access.
Production batch lookup binds exact batch ID and exact version.
Movement lookup binds exact movement ID.
Every durable row is reconstructed through canonical domain validation.
A found batch must exactly match the requested batch ID/version.
A found movement must exactly match the requested movement ID.
More than one durable row for an exact selector fails closed as storage-failure.
Malformed, uncertain or selector-divergent durable state fails closed as storage-failure.
Returned found values are canonical, detached and deeply frozen.
No pagination or enumeration is performed.
No FOOD-005Z or FOOD-006A projection is performed.
No evidence completeness or persistence cutoff is claimed.
No authoritative current quantity-on-hand is claimed.
No capacity, reservation, availability, checkout or payment readiness is claimed.
No migration definition changes or migration execution occur.
deferred: Persisted manifest evidence composition into FOOD-005Z batch balances.
Persisted batch balance composition into FOOD-006A exact-SKU recorded balance.
